name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-brokers-mcp
title: Iran Brokers Market Data
description: Read-only Iran broker data from Mofid and Agah: stocks, funds, options, bonds, gold, education.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_BROKERS_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for all Mofid and Agah requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next. Agah Pedia and Academy answer only from Iran, so do not use a foreign proxy for them.
